ha_attributes.whats_new:
4/16/2025 - Analyzer Framework Version 6.26.3

  • Fixes an error in the Patch Wizard analyzer when there are no previous Patch Wizard request_set_id
  • Adds tool tip to Arrow when expanding collapsing result data
  • Updates Java requirement to ensure the analyzers still work on EBS servers with Java 1.7
  • Fixed g_banner_message and g_banner_severity framework global variable handling nulls, which prevented these global variables to be populated in newer releases of EBS

Introducing the Oracle Applications Framework

The Oracle Applications Framework Analyzer is a self-service health-check script that reviews core Framework related data, analyzes current configurations and settings for the environment and provides feedback and recommendations on best practices.

The OA Framework Analyzer includes: 

  • Login
  • Patching
  • Homepage
  • Look and Feel
  • Session Management
  • Personalizations & Customizations
  • Connection Leaks
  • Database Parameter Settings
  • Security
  • Logging
